name: Curve
tagline: 3 BHK apartments proportioned to the golden ratio.
description: Curve is an apartment development under way in Vijayanagar 4th Stage. Its thirty-two 3 BHK homes are laid out on golden-ratio proportions, with landscaped ground-level gardens and a terrace pavilion.

items: 1200 × 1200 mm premium vitrified tiles to living and common areas
Glazed tiles to bathroom walls, full height
Main door in teak wood frame with veneer finish
Internal doors in wood frame with laminate finish
WPC frames and shutters to toilets
Power backup to common areas and lift
